verdict.gold_reason: Article 25(1) of Regulation 2016/1719 says TSOs coordinate curtailments of long-term capacity only for time frames of more than 48 hours before delivery. Within 48 hours, the day-ahead and intraday capacity calculation process of Article 29 of Regulation 2015/1222 applies. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is paraphrased: "multi-year border entitlements" stands for long-term transmission rights and "trimming" for curtailment. A reader could take it to mean the Article 53 firmness rules, but only Article 25(1) gives the 48-hour window and the replacement process.
